name: AI Airlock (PII redactor & token restorer)
description: Detect personal data (names, emails, SSN/NINO, IBAN, credit cards, phones, API keys) on your device, replace them with tokens ([PERSON_1], [EMAIL_1]) before pasting into ChatGPT/Claude, and restore real values locally afterwards.

seo.metaDescription: Detect personal data (names, emails, SSN/NINO, IBAN, credit cards, phones, API keys) on your device, replace them with tokens ([PERSON_1], [EMAIL_1]) before pasting into ChatGPT/Claude, and restore real values locally afterwards. seo.aeoSummary: AI Airlock (PII redactor & token restorer) processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using rampart-minilm-l6 (Tier M). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.q: Does AI Airlock (PII redactor & token restorer) upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. AI Airlock (PII redactor & token restorer) executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using rampart-minilm-l6. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate AI Airlock (PII redactor & token restorer)?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/ai_airlock.json or open /tools/ai-airlock?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
